gt_provenance.details: GSM8K: dataset answer field via #### separator. SocialIQA: dev-labels.lst dataset file. MedQA: answer_idx from jsonl dataset file. All three tasks use dataset-provided GT. No model output used.

score_normalization.details: MCQ accuracy = n_correct/n_items. No model-derived normalization. Spread = max(acc)-min(acc) over dataset-evaluated accuracies.

result_existence.details: M3 SocialIQA (26 files) and MedQA (26 files) result files exist per tracker (status=done, spread values reported). M4 analysis exists at reports/M4_c3_analysis.json. WARN: spread comparison conflates CoT (GSM8K) vs MCQ log-likelihood (SocialIQA, MedQA) evaluation modes — a known confound noted in EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md. Numbers match tracker (spread_social=0.030, spread_math=0.186, spread_factual=0.028).

dead_code.details: C2 spread computation in analyze_c3.py:155-178 is called in main() and output written to JSON. No dead code.

scope.details: 26 conditions × 500 items × 2 tasks = 26,000 evaluations — adequate quantity. WARN: evaluation mode differs across compared tasks (CoT generation vs MCQ log-likelihood), introducing a confound for cross-task spread comparison. The much larger GSM8K spread is partly explained by CoT variance, not solely by emotional framing effects.

checks.eval_type: real_gt (mixed modes: CoT for GSM8K, MCQ log-likelihood for SocialIQA and MedQA)
